name: The Butler Did It
tagline: A country house, a storm, a corpse, and a butler who knows too much.
description: Candlelight, cut-glass decanters and old money gone sour. The classic drawing-room whodunit: everyone has a secret, everyone has a motive, and everyone is looking at the butler.
artStyle: 1920s oil-painted portraiture, candlelit chiaroscuro, deep greens and burgundies, gilt frames, slightly noir

cocktails.name: The Butler's Revenge
cocktails.recipe: Gin, dry vermouth and a dash of orange bitters, stirred and served with a twist.
cocktails.mocktail: Tonic, a splash of elderflower cordial and a twist of orange.

cocktails.name: Port in a Storm
cocktails.recipe: Ruby port topped with soda water over ice.
cocktails.mocktail: Red grape juice topped with soda water and a slice of lemon.
